properties.name: Uttarapatha (Northern Highway / Grand Trunk Precursor)
properties.era: Vedic, Mauryan, Mughal to British Eras (c. 1000 BCE – Present)
properties.key_stations: Taxila, Lahore, Panipat, Delhi, Mathura, Kannauj, Prayagraj, Varanasi, Pataliputra, Champa, Tamralipti
properties.commodities: Silk, lapis lazuli, fine horses, Gandharan wool, Bengal muslins, iron tools, imperial edicts
properties.historical_accounts: Megasthenes (Indica), Xuanzang travels, Sher Shah Suri (Sadak-e-Azam), British Grand Trunk Road

properties.name: Dakshinapatha (Great Southern Highway)
properties.era: Mauryan, Satavahana, & Chola Eras (c. 500 BCE – 14th c. CE)
properties.key_stations: Varanasi, Kaushambi, Vidisha, Ujjayini, Maheshwar (Narmada), Pratishthana (Paithan), Tagara, Amaravati, Kanchipuram, Madurai
properties.commodities: Black pepper, pearls, beryls, cotton textiles, sandalwood, semi-precious carnelian beads
properties.historical_accounts: Arthashastra of Kautilya (Book VII praising southern wealth), Periplus of the Erythraean Sea

properties.name: Indian Ocean Maritime Monsoon Spice Route
properties.termini: Red Sea / Alexandria ↔ Muziris, Barygaza, Arikamedu & Malacca
properties.key_stations: Barygaza (Bharuch), Sopara, Muziris (Kodungallur), Korkai (Pandyan pearls), Arikamedu (Puducherry), Tamralipti
properties.commodities: Malabar black pepper ('Black Gold'), cinnamon, cardamom, Roman gold aurei, wine amphorae, Frankincense
properties.historical_accounts: Hippalus (discovery of monsoon navigation winds), Periplus of the Erythraean Sea, Pliny the Elder (Naturalis Historia)
